jobs.name: Clean up my wallet
jobs.description: Sweep small balances into one asset at a recipient address, without touching scam airdrops.

threshold_usd.label: Treat balances under this as dust (USD)

recipient.label: Send to a fresh address (generated in your browser)

metric.name: value_delivered
metric.description: Value delivered to the recipient, in USDC units (6 decimals)

jobs.name: Move everything to stables
jobs.description: Convert every non-scam token to USDC at a recipient address.

recipient.label: Send to a fresh address (generated in your browser)

jobs.name: Audit my wallet for scam tokens
jobs.description: Read-only: list tokens you should never interact with.

jobs.name: Claim my eligible airdrops
jobs.description: Find airdrops this wallet qualifies for and claim them to a fresh address.

recipient.label: Send to a fresh address (generated in your browser)

metric.name: value_delivered
metric.description: Value of claimed tokens, in USDC units

jobs.name: Revoke risky app keys
jobs.description: Every dApp you sign in to leaves a key on your account. Find the risky ones, revoke them with your approval, and see which full-access keys you should review.

jobs.name: Withdraw my unstaked NEAR
jobs.description: Find NEAR you unstaked and never withdrew, across every validator, and bring it back to your wallet. Also flags validators that stopped validating or charge high fees.

metric.name: value_delivered
metric.description: Value of the NEAR returned to your wallet, in USDC units

jobs.name: Check a contract before I sign
jobs.description: Before you connect your wallet or approve a transaction, check the contract: is it real code, who can change it, is its source published, does its name imitate a known app.

jobs.name: Cap my biggest positions
jobs.description: Sell just enough of any token that has grown above your cap, into a stablecoin, at a fresh address. Scam tokens are never touched.

max_share.label: Largest share any one token may have (%)

recipient.label: Send to a fresh address (generated in your browser)

metric.name: value_delivered
metric.description: USDC (or USDT) delivered to the recipient
